summary: Complete testing of System Reset (Danger Zone) feature. Backend: 10/10 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components verified. Fixed bug in frontend where result summary field names didn't match backend response. Added data-testid attributes for better testability.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Frontend Settings.jsx lines 1797-1801 had incorrect field names for reset summary (operators_deleted vs operators). Fixed to match backend response format.
Backend reset endpoints properly validate OTP expiry, admin ownership, and used status before executing reset.
Email service not configured in test environment - OTP request returns 500 with clear error message. This is expected behavior when email is not set up.
seed_data_creation: None - testing used existing admin account
context_for_next_testing_agent: System Reset (Danger Zone) feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: POST /api/admin/reset/request-otp (sends OTP to admin email), POST /api/admin/reset/execute (verifies OTP and deletes all data). Frontend: Danger Zone tab in Admin Settings with Complete System Reset section, OTP verification dialog. Note: Email service must be configured for OTP to be sent - in test environment, the endpoint returns 500 with 'No email delivery provider is configured' which is expected.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/admin/reset/request-otp requires authentication (401/403 without token)
Backend: POST /api/admin/reset/request-otp accessible with admin token (200 or 500 if email not configured)
Backend: POST /api/admin/reset/execute requires authentication (401/403 without token)
Backend: POST /api/admin/reset/execute without prior OTP request returns 400
Backend: POST /api/admin/reset/execute with invalid OTP returns 400
Backend: POST /api/admin/reset/execute validates OTP format (422 for empty)
Backend: Both reset endpoints exist and are not 404
Backend: Operator users cannot access reset endpoints (403)
Backend: OTP field is required in execute request body (422 if missing)
Backend: OTP accepts string values
Frontend: Danger Zone tab visible in Admin Settings with red styling
Frontend: Complete System Reset section displays all warning items
Frontend: IRREVERSIBLE warning displayed
Frontend: Reset Entire System button has destructive styling
Frontend: Reset confirmation dialog opens on button click
Frontend: Dialog shows 'Confirm System Reset' title
Frontend: Warning box 'Are you absolutely sure?' displayed
Frontend: Send OTP to Email button visible
Frontend: Error handling works when email service not configured
Frontend: data-testid attributes added for reset-entire-system-btn, send-otp-btn, reset-otp-input, confirm-reset-btn

bugs_fixed.issue: Reset result summary used incorrect field names (operators_deleted, invoices_deleted, etc.) that didn't match backend response (operators, invoices, etc.)
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated field names to match backend response format and added more fields (users, wallets, wallet_transactions, wa_logs)
